 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
 v_user uuid:=auth.uid();
 v_item uuid;
 v_claimant uuid;
 v_code text:=upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text,'-',''),1,6));
 v_deadline timestamptz:=now()+interval '48 hours';
begin
 if v_user is null then raise exception 'SIGNED_OUT'; end if;
 select c.item_id,c.claimant_id into v_item,v_claimant
 from public.marketplace_claims c join public.marketplace_items i on i.id=c.item_id
 where c.id=p_claim_id and c.status='requested' and i.seller_id=v_user and i.status='available'
 for update of c,i;
 if v_item is null then raise exception 'CLAIM_NOT_APPROVABLE'; end if;

 update public.marketplace_claims c
 set status='approved',approved_at=now(),pickup_deadline=v_deadline,pickup_code=v_code,updated_at=now()
 where c.id=p_claim_id;

 update public.marketplace_claims c
 set status='declined',declined_at=now(),counts_toward_quota=false,updated_at=now()
 where c.item_id=v_item and c.id<>p_claim_id and c.status='requested';

 update public.marketplace_items i set status='pending_pickup',updated_at=now() where i.id=v_item;

 insert into public.marketplace_claim_events(claim_id,actor_user_id,event_type,metadata)
 values(p_claim_id,v_user,'approved',jsonb_build_object('pickup_deadline',v_deadline));

 insert into public.user_notifications(user_id,category,title,body,route,metadata)
 values(v_claimant,'marketplace_claim','Marketplace claim approved','You have 48 hours to pick up your item. Open your claim for private pickup details and verification code.','/marketplace-claim/'||p_claim_id,jsonb_build_object('claim_id',p_claim_id,'item_id',v_item));

 insert into public.user_notifications(user_id,category,title,body,route,metadata)
 select c.claimant_id,'marketplace_claim','Marketplace claim update','Another claimant was selected for this item. This declined request does not count against your monthly claim limit.','/marketplace-claim/'||c.id,jsonb_build_object('claim_id',c.id,'item_id',v_item)
 from public.marketplace_claims c where c.item_id=v_item and c.status='declined' and c.declined_at>=now()-interval '5 seconds';

 return query select c.id,c.status,c.pickup_deadline,c.pickup_code from public.marketplace_claims c where c.id=p_claim_id;
end; $function$

","signature":"remove_marketplace_item(uuid)"},{"acl":["postgres=X/postgres","service_role=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"],"def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_marketplace_claim(p_item_id uuid, p_message text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
 v_user uuid:=auth.uid();
 v_seller uuid;
 v_status text;
 v_moderation text;
 v_limit integer:=1;
 v_used integer:=0;
 v_existing public.marketplace_claims%rowtype;
 v_created public.marketplace_claims%rowtype;
 v_has_existing boolean:=false;
begin
 if v_user is null then raise exception 'SIGNED_OUT'; end if;

 select i.seller_id,i.status,i.moderation_status into v_seller,v_status,v_moderation
 from public.marketplace_items i where i.id=p_item_id;

 if v_seller is null then raise exception 'ITEM_NOT_FOUND'; end if;
 if v_seller=v_user then raise exception 'OWN_ITEM'; end if;
 if v_status<>'available' or v_moderation<>'approved' then raise exception 'ITEM_UNAVAILABLE'; end if;

 select * into v_existing from public.marketplace_claims c
 where c.item_id=p_item_id and c.claimant_id=v_user;
 v_has_existing:=found;

 if v_has_existing and v_existing.status in ('requested','approved','ready','picked_up','no_show') then
   return query select v_existing.id,v_existing.status,v_existing.created_at;
   return;
 end if;

 if exists(
  select 1 from public.fairpath_subscriptions s
  where s.user_id=v_user and s.plan='fairpath_plus' and s.status='active'
    and (s.current_period_end is null or s.current_period_end>now())
 ) then v_limit:=7; end if;

 select count(*) into v_used
 from public.marketplace_claims c
 where c.claimant_id=v_user
   and c.created_at>=date_trunc('month',now())
   and c.created_at<date_trunc('month',now())+interval '1 month'
   and c.counts_toward_quota;

 if v_used>=v_limit then raise exception 'CLAIM_LIMIT_REACHED'; end if;

 if v_has_existing then
   update public.marketplace_claims c set
     status='requested',counts_toward_quota=true,pickup_deadline=null,pickup_code=null,
     approved_at=null,ready_at=null,completed_at=null,cancelled_at=null,declined_at=null,no_show_at=null,
     created_at=now(),updated_at=now()
   where c.id=v_existing.id
   returning * into v_created;
 else
   insert into public.marketplace_claims(item_id,claimant_id,status,counts_toward_quota,updated_at)

  end if;

  select a.application_type,a.listing_id,l.required_application_documents

  join public.housing_listings l on l.id=a.listing_id
  where a.id=p_application_id
    and a.user_id=v_user
    and a.status='started';

  if v_type is null then raise exception 'APPLICATION_NOT_SUBMITTABLE'; end if;
  if v_type='fasttrack' and coalesce((p_consent->>'fasttrack_ack')::boolean,false) is not true then
    raise exception 'FASTTRACK_ACK_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  if length(trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'first_name','')))<2
     or length(trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'last_name','')))<2
     or trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'email','')) !~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'

     or trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'date_of_birth','')) !~ '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'
     or trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'pets',''))=''
     or trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'housing_history',''))=''
     or trim(coalesce(p_answers->>'references',''))='' then

    raise exception 'APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE';
  end;
  if v_occupants<1 then raise exception 'APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE'; end if;

  begin
    v_income := regexp_replace(coalesce(p_answers->>'monthly_income',''),'[^0-9.]','','g')::numeric;

      current_step=5,
      status='submitted',
      submitted_at=v_now,
      updated_at=v_now,
      applicant_snapshot=p_answers,
      consent_snapshot=p_consent||jsonb_build_object('confirmed_at',v_now)
  where a.id=p_application_id
    and a.user_id=v_user
    and a.status='started';

  select a.id,a.status,a.submitted_at
  from public.housing_applications a
  where a.id=p_application_id and a.user_id=v_user;
